subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should the Android chat message action menu include only Copy and Select Copy first, or also ship Share and Reply in the same feature?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested action set mixes low-risk clipboard behavior with Share and Reply UX that changes composer behavior and review scope.

options.title: Ship Copy and Select Copy First
options.body: Approve a smaller long-press menu focused on whole-message copy and selectable text, with Share and Reply left to follow-up issues if still desired.

options.title: Ship Full Four-Action Menu
options.body: Approve Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply together, accepting a broader Android UI and composer behavior review.

options.title: Adopt the Fork PR After Refresh
options.body: Ask maintainers to refresh and review https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1851 as the implementation path if they want to preserve that branch.

recommendation.title: Ship Copy and Select Copy First
recommendation.body: Approve a smaller long-press menu focused on whole-message copy and selectable text, with Share and Reply left to follow-up issues if still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent commits point to steipete across the active Android chat rendering files, and this is a product-scope UI decision rather than a strict bug fix.
